title: Guild Board 1.6.0
sub: PATCH NOTES  ·  DUNGEON QUESTS, DING UNLOCKS AND SOUL SHARDS

rows.label: NEW
items: Every quest your group has for the run, who has it and who's done. Share or Ask in one click.
Level up and the popup names your new trainer spells and class quests. Thanks Blexas.
Warlocks get a draggable box that deletes one shard per click. Thanks John.
Greed on gear, Pass on the rest. Off until you turn it on in the minimap menu.

rows.label: BETTER
items: Swap gear is safe and there's a Keep list for anything you never want sold. Thanks medi.
One button in the quest log drops every quest that's gray to you.
The mail button now says who gets what and fills in the full name.
Left-click opens Party & Upkeep. The To-Do List takes a break and comes back later.

rows.label: FIXED
items: Party & Upkeep no longer throws an error once you zone into an instance.

footer: Update from the pin in #addons  ·  CurseForge auto updates once approved  ·  /gb bug to report issues
